name: Amyrina
source:
Favorite food: Spicy chinese food
Hobbies: Exploring, choir activities
Skills: Singing, studying

1st-year student of Ryuusaki Academy who transferred into class 1-C. Like [url=/c3405]Lolotte[/url] and [url=/c3806]Azel[/url], she is also an angel, and also happens to be one of Lolotte's best friends. Amyrina is part of the school's choir, and in order to have a voice like an angel's, she practices hard every day.
